skills.text: Choose two zones within 5 zones: 1 Zone gets ice cold, all creatures in it gain the conditions suppressed (grip-rescue-check) and stunned (metabolism-rescue-check), in the other all take X energy damage.

skills.name: Muto Aqua
skills.text: Healing water flows through you, heal 1 creature within 5 zones by X. Everytime one creature profits from this skill, it heals 5 less until the end of the day.

skills.name: Creo Aura
skills.text: Piercing winds: Sharp winds give all creatures in your zone a penalyt of X to their timing rolls and their action penalty is doubled. The wind follow you for 3 rounds.

skills.name: Rego Corpus
skills.text: 1 target within 15 zones, the target takes X/2 energy damage and gains the condition stunned (grounding-rescue-check)

skills.name: Perdo Imagem
skills.text: 1 target within 15 zones, the target takes X/2 energy damage and gains the condition blinded 3 (grounding-rescue-check)

skills.name: Creo Mentem
skills.text: 1 target within 15 zones, the target gains the condition enslaved (focus-rescue-check)

skills.name: Rego Astrum
skills.text: Take control of any magical effect within 15 zones and change its target or duration.

skills.name: Redemption
skills.text: 1 target within 10 zones, gains the condition stunned (focus-rescue-check) with a penalty of 10-Y, where Y are the zones between you and the target.

skills.name: Subtraction
skills.text: Melee attack, 1 target own zone. Deal X-1 damage, the target cannot perform a rescue-check to reduce this damage.

skills.name: Absolute
skills.text: 1 target within 10 zones, gains the condition enslaved (focus-rescue-check) with a penalty of 5-Y, where Y are the zones between you and the target.

skills.name: Celestial fire
skills.text: Melee area attack, own and adjacend zones, enemies take X energy damage.
